description: This file defines the AdminSidebar React component for Mattermost's admin console, including rendering the sidebar menu, handling search/filtering, and managing plugin and section visibility.

classes.name: AdminSidebar
classes.description: React component for the admin console sidebar with search and plugin support.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Initializes plugin fetching and sets focus on search input.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Updates index when plugins or admin definition change.

methods.name: handleSearchChange
methods.description: Handles search input changes, updates visible sections, and manages URL navigation.

methods.name: updateTitle
methods.description: Updates the document title based on current site name.

methods.name: visibleSections
methods.description: Determines which sections are visible based on configuration and permissions.

methods.name: renderRootMenu
methods.description: Renders the main menu structure based on admin definition.

methods.name: isPluginPresentInSections
methods.description: Checks if a plugin is included in the current visible sections.

methods.name: renderPluginsMenu
methods.description: Renders plugin entries in the sidebar menu.

methods.name: handleClearFilter
methods.description: Clears the search filter and resets visible sections.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the entire sidebar component including search input and menu.
